title: Mountable Dual Hose Separator (Braided rubber 6AN)
description: Behold! FLF’s Mountable Dual Hose Separator these CAD-designed pieces are 3D-printed from an extremely durable and temperature-resistant polymer with brass thread inserts for long service life. They feature M6 flanged bolts for even clamping force and convenient application. No need to hunt down the allen key, a simple 10mm socket will do the trick (assuming you can find it).
